panels.description: Inside the old works, a nearly dry residential pipe runs beside a full industrial uplink and its data line. Alex, Ada and B11 stand on the inspection walkway; leave upper pipe space.
Alex clamps the Measure to the residential pipe. Keep the transparent lens, folded arms and physical pipe connection clear.
Alex clamps the Measure's second arm to the data line beside the industrial uplink. Ada watches the physical connection; leave upper space.
The Measure compares the physical flow and official reading while Alex, Ada and B11 look at the same device. Keep the discrepancy display unobstructed.
